Pinned REAPER extension DLLs bundled by installer/setup.iss.

reaper_imgui64.dll
  Source:  cfillion/reaimgui
  Version: v0.10.0.5
  From:    https://github.com/cfillion/reaimgui/releases/download/v0.10.0.5/reaper_imgui-x64.dll
  Renamed from reaper_imgui-x64.dll to reaper_imgui64.dll (REAPER's own
  UserPlugins naming convention - REAPER doesn't require this exact name
  to load a plugin, but it matches what ReaPack itself would name it).

reaper_reapack64.dll
  Source:  cfillion/reapack
  Version: v1.2.6
  From:    https://github.com/cfillion/reapack/releases/download/v1.2.6/reaper_reapack-x64.dll
  Renamed from reaper_reapack-x64.dll to reaper_reapack64.dll, same reason.

To update: download the new release's *-x64.dll asset from the
